row.notes: Weekly per-decal income count (career.my_team_sponsors.weekly_income_per_decal_thresholds). Branch A (no per-decal data) sums 0x141103de0 = unlocked slots per area at renown minus reserved; branch B counts saved livery nodes (cust+0xe8..+0xf0, 16-byte entries) minus reserved per area. Not sponsor-specific: every placed decal pays, reserved (title) slots do not. Site 0x141104491 (rsi = count, r15 = livery).

verify.notes: V9154 Branch A sums 141103de0 minus reserved per area, branch B uses (livery +0xf0 - +0xe8)>>4 minus reserved; only the weekly-income-threshold meaning is not provable from the code.
